summary: Enable eAPI on a new EOS switch over CLI with eos_eapi enable_http/enable_https and become enable, then switch group_vars to the httpapi connection.
questions: How do I enable eAPI on an Arista switch with Ansible?
Do I need enable mode to turn on eAPI?

answer_card.title: Enable eAPI on EOS
answer_card.answer_md:
Using the CLI connection settings:
```yaml
- name: Enable eAPI
  arista.eos.eos_eapi:
    enable_http: yes
    enable_https: yes
  become: true
  become_method: enable
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'
```
Then change `group_vars/eos.yml` to `ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.httpapi`.
